decisions.reason: The current published supplier proof 1.1 explicitly proves equivariant symmetrization and gr Z=R; 2.1 chooses the harmonic lifts and 3.1 proves they are a filtered Z-basis. Thus F5 and steps 6.2–7.1 use established local arguments, not abstract freeness alone. Independently checked the finite-character constant term, bounded root shifts, nonnegative-integral coefficient limit and extension by complete reducibility.

For T=C(t), (0) is a closed point with residue field C(t), and any purported C-algebra map to C would kill an invertible t-c. Replaced the undefined C-valued fiber at arbitrary closed points by tensoring with kappa(p), with explicit highest weight lambda+epsilon_p; ordinary complex fibers are retained at complex-valued points. PBW, finite tensor flags, origin CRT components and relative weight projectivity remain valid.

F6 is proved in the cited supplier, not inferred from its short Statement: free-over-center Proof 1.1 establishes gr Z=S(g)^g by equivariant symmetrization, and 2.1–3.1 establish the filtered harmonic basis. Consequently central reduction in 2.2 has the harmonic quotient basis and the stated Hilbert series. Checked the regular sequence, principal sl2 strings and weighted slice Jacobian, nilpotent conjugacy, generic reducedness and Cohen–Macaulay associated-prime detection; no defect was found.

The original 3.2 applies the quotient Hilbert bound to U_chi itself, contradicting 2.3. Corrected it to gr(U_chi/K)=A/gr K and a filtered injection of U(n-) tensor U(n+) into U_chi/K, giving n^(2N) lower growth versus O(n^(2N-1)). Checked the simple-Verma restriction, tensor freeness, polynomial-kernel rank and finite isotypic dimension arguments; the Statement is unchanged.

The concluding assertion that the whole-object multiplicity formula holds for individual direct summands is false: the zero summand already contradicts it. The correct Statement was proved before that assertion by exact pushforward and concatenation of flags. Replaced the ancillary assertion with additive multiplicities across Y direct-sum Z; verified the dominant two-factor interface directly in the wall-crossing definition and its norm-bound calculation. No Statement change.

The Statement falsely applies unique new top-label summands to every expression. In rank one, the nonreduced word ss=e gives theta_s^2 Delta(lambda)=P(s.lambda) direct-sum P(s.lambda), with no P(e.lambda). Added reducedness exactly as required by F2 and Proof 6.2; no equivalence or labeling conclusion was weakened. Checked deformed wall maps 1.2, localized words 2.1, height-one/UFD full faithfulness 3.1, reduction of Hom 4.1, absolute indecomposability and normalization 5.1–6.1, and inverse-label induction.

The displayed polynomial B_s has right k[a]-rank two and infinite k-dimension; only bar B_s=B_s tensor_(k[a]) k is C(1) of dimension two. Corrected the dimension comparison to name both objects and the reduction map. The projective wall-crossing matrix and four-dimensional coinvariant tensor were already correct; made onto-wall equality and preservation of projectivity explicit to justify the decompositions.
